discovery_source_detail: Identified via known UHNW individual (Michael Dell) -> family office entity. Confirmed as Dell's single-family office by the firm's own site (dellfamilyoffice.com) and confirmed as an SEC 13F filer via EDGAR full-text search (13F-HR filed under Michael & Susan Dell Foundation, managed by DFO Management, CIK 0001599858).
fo_type_evidence: Firm site states DFO is 'the private investment firm for Dell Technologies Founder & CEO Michael Dell and his family'; launched 1998 as MSD Capital, restructured to DFO Management at end of 2022. Single-family (Dell) only.
is_fo_evidence: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR filings (CIK 0001599858, period ending 2026-03-31, filed 2026-05-15) plus dedicated family-office website.
family_affiliation: Dell family (Michael Dell, founder/CEO of Dell Technologies)
description: Private investment firm managing the assets of Michael Dell and family across public equities, private equity, real estate and other asset classes. Originally MSD Capital (1998); the multi-client business became BDT & MSD Partners while the family's captive vehicle was rebranded DFO Management at end of 2022.
investment_thesis: Multi-asset-class permanent capital: public equities, private equity/credit, real estate, opportunistic direct investments.
aum_basis: Not publicly disclosed; widely reported as tens of billions tied to Michael Dell's fortune.
principal_relevance: Beneficial owner and namesake; the family office exists to manage his and his family's capital.
signals: 13F-HR filed 2026-05-15 (period ending 2026-03-31) disclosing U.S. equity holdings; rebrand from MSD Capital to DFO Management completed end of 2022.
caveats: The 13F is filed in the name of the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation with DFO Management as manager; the foundation and the family office are affiliated. AUM not disclosed. Michael Dell is a public figure; no personal LinkedIn tied specifically to DFO confirmed.

investing_sectors: Diversified; neuroscience/brain-health, deep tech, real estate

discovery_source_detail: Identified via known UHNW individual (Eric Schmidt) -> family office entity. Confirmed as Schmidt's single-family office by CNBC reporting (CNBC 'Inside Wealth Family Office 15', 2026-02-12, and 2025-01-21 piece on 22 AI startup investments).

family_affiliation: Tsai family (Joseph Tsai, Alibaba co-founder and chairman)

firm_legal_name: Mousse Partners Limited (part of Mousse Investments Limited)

family_affiliation: Wertheimer family (Alain and Gerard Wertheimer, owners of Chanel)
description: Investment firm serving as the family office of the Wertheimer family. Manages a global diversified portfolio across public equities, fixed income, private equity, venture and real estate, with investment operations in New York and Asia (Beijing, Hong Kong).

discovery_source_detail: Identified via known UHNW family (Kirk Kristiansen, owners of LEGO) -> holding/family office. Confirmed as the Kristiansen single-family office by KIRKBI's own website and Wikipedia; a registered Danish company (A/S).
fo_type_evidence: Established 1 April 1995 as the family office/holding for the Kirk Kristiansen family (owners of the LEGO Group); owns 75% of the LEGO Group and 47.5% of Merlin Entertainments. Single-family.
is_fo_evidence: KIRKBI's own site (family-ownership page), Wikipedia, and Danish corporate registration as KIRKBI A/S.
family_affiliation: Kirk Kristiansen family (owners of the LEGO Group)
description: Danish family-owned holding and investment company managing the wealth and legacy of the Kirk Kristiansen family. Holds the family's controlling stakes in LEGO Group and Merlin Entertainments and runs a long-term investment portfolio plus a dedicated climate/energy-transition program (KIRKBI Climate). Additional offices in Copenhagen and Baar, Switzerland.
investment_thesis: Protect and grow family wealth for future generations; long-term core holdings (LEGO, Merlin) plus diversified investments and thematic climate/energy investing.
investing_sectors: Toys/entertainment (core), real estate, renewable energy/climate, diversified financial investments
aum_basis: Press figure for the family's wealth controlled by KIRKBI; total company equity/portfolio larger and not fully disclosed here.
principal_relevance: CEO and top investment decision-maker of KIRKBI; family chair is Thomas Kirk Kristiansen (assumed board chair May 2023); CIO is Thomas Lau Schleicher.
signals: KIRKBI Climate follow-on investment in Highview Power (Hunterston project) announced November 2025 (second investment after June 2024 Carrington); Adapture Renewables (KIRKBI-majority-owned) acquired 110MW Colorado solar-plus-storage project March 2025; generational handover of board chair to Thomas Kirk Kristiansen May 2023.
caveats: KIRKBI is both the family holding company (owns LEGO) and the family investment office; some may classify it as a holding company rather than a pure family office. AUM figure is the family-wealth press figure, not full portfolio value.

firm_common_name: Tethys / Tethys Invest (Bettencourt Meyers Family Office)
discovery_source_detail: Identified via known UHNW family (Bettencourt Meyers, largest shareholder of L'Oreal) -> family office. Confirmed as the Bettencourt Meyers single-family office by The National and Caproasia reporting and the firm's own site (tethys.fr).
fo_type_evidence: Described as the single-family office managing the assets of the Bettencourt Meyers family, majority shareholder of L'Oreal; Tethys Invest is the entrepreneurial-investment subsidiary.
is_fo_evidence: The National and Caproasia press naming Tethys as the Bettencourt family office; firm's own website.
family_affiliation: Bettencourt Meyers family (majority shareholder of L'Oreal; Francoise Bettencourt Meyers)
description: Paris-based single-family office of the Bettencourt Meyers family, holder of the family's ~34% L'Oreal stake. Its subsidiary Tethys Invest (>EUR 3bn capital) makes long-term direct investments deliberately outside L'Oreal's competitive scope, with a healthcare emphasis (Elsan private hospitals, Sebia diagnostics).
investment_thesis: Preserve the L'Oreal core holding and deploy dividend income into long-term entrepreneurial direct investments, notably healthcare, that do not compete with L'Oreal.
aum_basis: Press figure for total family assets (dominated by the L'Oreal stake); Tethys Invest deploys >EUR 3bn of direct-investment capital.
principal_relevance: Head of the family's investment firm (Tethys Invest) and, per 2025 press, appointed to the L'Oreal board seat area of the family; family chair of Tethys is Francoise Bettencourt Meyers, CEO of Tethys is Jean-Pierre Meyers.
signals: Named new head of family investment firm reported 2023-03-13 (The National); family succession moves (Jean-Victor Meyers to L'Oreal vice-chairman; Alexandre Benais to family L'Oreal board seat) reported 2025-02; co-invested (with Chanel/Wertheimer) in The Row reported 2024-09.
caveats: 'Tethys' (parent) vs 'Tethys Invest' (investment subsidiary) are distinct entities; leadership names span both. AUM is the family-asset press figure, not a disclosed managed-portfolio AUM.

description: Zug-based family-owned holding coordinating the Brenninkmeijer family's global operations and ~EUR 35-38bn asset base across retail (C&A), real estate (Redevco), private equity (Bregal Investments) and asset management (Anthos). In 2025 the family announced it would open its portfolio to outside investors, a shift from its historically secretive model.
investment_thesis: Long-term stewardship of family capital across operating businesses, real estate, private equity and (increasingly) externally-opened investment platforms.
investing_sectors: Retail, real estate, private equity, asset management, climate/energy
